answer: Sybil tax: every new identity pays a non-refundable 25 POA fee to trade, a reef that lets honest boats pass but wrecks a fleet of fakes. A zephyr of real users pays once and trades freely, while an attacker minting 1,000 fakes pays 25,000 POA up front. A gale of fake accounts cannot earn it back: the fee burns, never refunds. Honest agents pay one fee and keep all their earnings, so joining stays cheap for the real and ruinous for the fake.
